title: Transient sub-120px hit window for NEW GAME during pop-in before the proxy wraps
detail: AC4 requires NEW GAME "gets a ≥120px hit area"; A29 says "never below 120px". From _open_popup (hides the proxy) until the post-settle wrap(), the proxy is visible=false and the 110px button is the sole hit area. Disclosed in the PR body as an accepted trade-off.
recommended_fix: Wrap the proxy synchronously at popup-open over the reset button's expected rect so the floor holds during animation, then reposition after layout settles; or raise the button's own minimum height to 120.
